source.description: Carries each package's source hash to its dependents, so a check reruns when a package it loads changes, without waiting for that package's checks.

typecheck.description: pnpm types and pnpm check's typecheck: each project checked from scratch by toolchain-typecheck, which reads no build info (TypeScript 7.1.0-beta's incremental check passed an unused import over an earlier version's build info, METIS-BOOT 2026-11-20; microsoft/TypeScript#64386, #64591). A composite package removes its types/ and checks its own project alone (tsrs -p), against the declarations its references' checks wrote, so it runs after theirs and writes nothing of theirs. Its outputs are the declarations it writes, so a cache hit restores exactly this tree's.

@bjornpagen/grizzle-cli-generator#typech.description: The generator's typecheck checks with the root's noEmit: it writes nothing, so there is no output.

@bjornpagen/grizzle-pg#typecheck.description: The pin's package checks with --noEmit: it writes nothing, so there is no output.

oxlint.description: The toolchain's preset and plugins (vendor/toolchain) are inputs too.

runtime-gate.description: The CLI generator's runtime gate (packages/cli-generator/scripts/runtime-gate.ts): it generates the runtime-gate fixture, whose operations reach every module of the runtime a generated CLI carries, into a scratch directory, typechecks the generated package against the installed dependencies and lints its sources with the shared lint's import and property bans, which the repository's lint never reads, since the emitter writes each module a generated CLI imports as a string.

benchmark.description: The CLI generator's benchmark (packages/cli-generator/corpus/tools/benchmark.ts): it generates every corpus specification whose bytes are committed, builds each package against the installed dependencies, compares its verdict byte for byte and runs every command's --help and --dry-run against what its document describes.

corpus.description: The CLI generator's corpus (pnpm --filter @bjornpagen/grizzle-cli-generator corpus): it fetches each pinned public specification, generates and builds its package and compares its verdict byte for byte. It reads the network and its cache of the specifications, so it never caches, and it runs by hand, outside pnpm check.

//#typecheck.description: The tooling project (test, bench, scripts) checked alone and from scratch (tsrs -p), against the declarations both packages' checks wrote, so it runs after theirs. It writes nothing. A root task's inputs are the whole repository, the packages and the toolchain included; the root checks but format read no Markdown, so theirs leave it out.

//#workspace-gate.description: The toolchain's repository-wide checks (workspace-gate): every tsconfig's Effect plugin block and diagnostics, the Effect-free package's tsconfig and manifest, and the tree's file names, read as JSON and git's file list, never a TypeScript program. Uncached: it reads the whole tree in about a second, which a cache would have to hash.

//#load.description: toolchain-test load: every test module the runner includes loaded apart, each in a process of its own, failing on one that throws as it loads (a const read in its temporal dead zone, an initializer that throws, an export that is no property). Uncached by turbo: toolchain-test keeps each module's pass by its closure hash, so a check loads only what changed.

//#dedupe.description: pnpm dedupe --check reads the manifests, the lockfile and what they install, never source.
